## Change

Describe the problem, concrete resulting behavior and affected platform or documentation.

## Validation

- Commands run and results:
- Device/model/firmware/OS actually tested, or explicitly untested:
- UI screenshots if relevant, with personal data removed:

## Protocol/model evidence, if relevant

- Source/capture/inference and sanitized vectors:
- Family document/support-matrix updates:
- Reported-state confirmation and remaining restrictions:

## Review

- [ ] I understand this code and can explain it, including any AI-generated parts.
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated; no dead local references.
- [ ] No personal logs, signing files, secrets or distribution outputs added.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have provenance and required notices.
- [ ] Results distinguish automated/simulated checks from physical testing.
